scientific_hypothesis: Adding anti-reflection matching layers at the air interface will reduce passband ripple in the 1530-1565 nm transmission band while maintaining visible band reflectance.
expected_advantages: Reduced passband ripple compared to unmatched Bragg stack
Better transmission uniformity across 1530-1565 nm band
known_risks: AR layers may reduce visible band reflectance
May not improve overall target score if ripple is not limiting factor
expected_observations: If hypothesis holds: best_target_score should show improved passband uniformity compared to route_01, with valid_candidates stable
If hypothesis fails: best_target_score should match route_01, indicating AR layers provide no benefit for this band combination
tightest_margin should improve if ripple reduction is achieved
stop_conditions: If best_target_score improves by less than 1e-3 against the historical best for two consecutive rounds, treat the axis as exhausted, stop and keep the current best
If AR layer thicknesses converge to near-zero values, AR matching is not beneficial; stop and keep Bragg-only design
